t: Know anything about Kohler Neoroc quartz composite sinks?
s: I believe the Neoroc has a gel coat. Looks great when new but after a few years, you can get scratches or discoloration. Look for a composite sink that is solid through the thickness. Those you can sand down, polish and renew after years of use. Elkay quartz is a good one. If you are looking for a workstation I have used the Ruvati granite composite workstation and it's very well built. They are made in Italy but better priced than Kohler Neoroc which are made in Mexico.
